    RACES.NAME

LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M' THEN ID ELSE NULL END) > 
             COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' AND SEX = 'M' THEN ID ELSE NULL END) THEN 'In-Patient'
        ELSE 'Outpatient'
    END AS Gender,
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M' THEN ID ELSE NULL END) - 
     COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' AND SEX = 'M' THEN ID ELSE NULL END)) * 100 / 
     COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M' THEN ID ELSE NULL END) AS Deviation

    Patient AS p

    Examination AS e ON p.ID = e.ID

    Laboratory AS lab ON p.ID = lab.ID

    Gender
ORDER BY 
    Deviation DESC
